light_description: Handmade Tokyo fuzz with octave/gated behavior, independent clean boost and concrete enclosure; documented as the first designed pedal of West Tokyo Waves.

Seven-transistor handmade Tokyo overdrive/fuzz with individually weathered concrete/metal finishes; current 2026 product.
